arguments.premise_synthesis: Systems where interactions produce or destroy value follow power law distributions, not normal distributions. Examples from nature and society confirm that a small minority holds the majority of value (e.g., 10% of galaxies hold 90% of stars, 10% of cities hold 90% of population, 10% of people hold 90% of wealth, 10% of musicians are listened to 90% of the time). Therefore, wealth inequality is structural and inevitable, and AI cannot change this fundamental distribution.
arguments.conclusion_supported: It is established that wealth inequality follows a power law distribution that is immutable by economic or political means, so AI cannot solve poverty by altering the distribution.
